# ADR-3102: A09: PII-rich debug logging for request 6

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Over-logging creates privacy incidents.

## Decision

Services SHALL NOT enable PII-rich debug logging for request 6 (A09-6) unless an exception is explicitly documented.

## Consequences

Field allow-lists govern log payloads.
